original.target_description: Grades 3–5 children in two schools; ITBS Total Reading posttest adjusted for pretest; planned ANCOVA contrast Books with Oral Reading and Comprehension Scaffolding versus Control.

n.quote: All subsequent analyses of the treatment effects were based on the final analytic sample of 400 children.
n.sample_role: Children in the four-condition ANCOVA supporting the planned contrast; not just the two contrasted arms.
n.exclusions: 514 pretested; 401 with pretest and posttest after moving/absence attrition; one extreme regression outlier removed.

es.location: Author manuscript p. 21, Posttests: Treatment Effects; Table 2 contrast
es.quote: The effect size, calculated as the difference between adjusted posttest means divided by the pooled standard deviation, was + .14.

p.location: Author manuscript p. 21, first planned comparison
p.quote: Scaffolding versus Control, was significant, t (395) = 2.22, p < .03.

replication.target_description: All 19 schools, pooled lesson routines; ITBS reading comprehension posttest; basic teacher lessons and summer books (TL-SB) versus control, OLS Model 1 with pretest covariate.

n.location: Author manuscript p. 74, Table 4, N row, Model 1
n.sample_role: Children included in the three-condition OLS Model 1, clustered within 19 schools; not merely the basic-treatment and control arms.
n.exclusions: Pretest N = 1,421; posttest N = 1,189, 16% attrition. Table 3 arm counts sum to 1,188, conflicting with Table 4 Model 1 N = 1189; model-specific printed N retained.

es.location: Author manuscript p. 74, Table 4, TL-SB row, Model 1
es.metric: OLS treatment coefficient on z-standardized pretest/posttest measures (standardized covariate-adjusted group difference)

p.location: Author manuscript p. 74, Table 4, TL-SB row, Model 1; p. 32 treatment effects

reported_success.location: Author manuscript pp. 37–38, Non-Replication in the Full Sample of Moderate and High Poverty Schools
reported_success.quote: was not replicated in the full sample of schools.

notes: Primary full manuscripts read via web parser; frozen excerpts cached with source URLs and manuscript pagination. Published locator pagination differs from the author manuscripts. Neutral description interpreted as the full oral-reading/comprehension intervention versus control originally, and basic TL-SB versus control across all schools in replication; other planned contrasts, enhanced treatment and poverty interactions are distinct. Replication requested b (unstd), but the paper explicitly standardizes pretest and posttest: printed coefficient retained without conversion. No exact p or explicit numeric bound is printed for TL-SB Model 1; narrative reports no difference, and absence of a significance marker is not converted to a bound. Narrative verdict refers to full-sample replication; authors separately describe positive effects in high-poverty schools.
